description:
Das Spital Emmental sorgt mit Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten an den beiden Spitalstandorten Burgdorf und Langnau für die hochstehende medizinische Versorgung von 150 000 Einwohnerinnen und Einwohnern – rund um die Uhr.

Bei uns erwartet dich ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag: Du begleitest Patientinnen und Patienten individuell in der ambulanten und stationären Betreuung und bringst dein Fachwissen direkt in deren Therapie ein. Besonders wichtig ist uns die enge interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit – denn gemeinsam erreichen wir die besten Ergebnisse für unsere Patientinnen und Patienten. Für die Ernährungsberatung am Standort Burgdorf suchen wir ab 1. September 2026 befristet bis 30. April 2027 im Rahmen einer Mutterschaftsvertretung eine:n

Deine Aufgaben

• Du führst ambulante Beratungen in verschiedenen Fachbereichen durch und begleitest Patientinnen und Patienten individuell
• Du führst stationäre Ernährungstherapien durch in verschiedenen Fachgebieten (oral, enteral, parenteral)
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Ärztinnen und Ärzten entwickelst du massgeschneiderte Ernährungsstrategien und trägst so aktiv zur Verbesserung der Behandlungsergebnisse bei
• Betreuung von Studierenden
• Durchführung von Vorträgen im Rahmen von Projekten oder ambulanten Rehabilitationen wie z.B. Pulmorehabilitation und Kardiologische Rehabilitation)

Dein Profil – was du mitbringst

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium Ernährung und Diätetik BSc
• Die Zusammenarbeit im interprofessionellen Team ist für dich selbstverständlich und bereichernd
• Als echte:r Teamplayer:in bringst du dich aktiv ein und unterstützt deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen gerne
• Du bist eine engagierte, dienstleistungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die Patientinnen und Patienten kompetent und empathisch begleitet

Unser Angebot
Ferien GAV Kulinarisches Modern Menschlich Mittendrin Parkieren Anlässe Rabatte

Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen und eine faire, leistungsorientierte Vergütung runden unser Angebot ab.

Joel Blank HR

Spital Emmental AG HR 3400 Burgdorf www.spital-emmental.ch Wir sind Modern – Menschlich – Mittendrin und freuen uns auf alle! Con specialisti nelle due sedi ospedaliere di Burgdorf e Langnau, l'Ospedale Emmental garantisce assistenza medica di alta qualità a 150.000 residenti – 24 ore su 24. Da noi vi aspetta una routine lavorativa quotidiana varia: accompagnate i pazienti individualmente nelle cure ambulatoriali e stazionarie e apportate le vostre conoscenze specialistiche direttamente alla loro terapia. Per noi è particolarmente importante una stretta collaborazione interdisciplinare, perché insieme otteniamo i migliori risultati per i nostri pazienti. Per consulenza nutrizionale presso la sede di Burgdorf cerchiamo un rappresentante della maternità dal 1° settembre 2026 al 30 aprile 2027: l'Ospedale Emmental fornisce assistenza medica di alta qualità a 150.000 residenti - 24 ore su 24 - con specialisti nelle due sedi ospedaliere di Burgdorf e Langnau. Per noi è particolarmente importante una stretta collaborazione interdisciplinare, perché insieme otteniamo i migliori risultati per i nostri pazienti. • Effettuate visite ambulatoriali in diverse aree specialistiche e accompagnate i pazienti individualmente

• In stretta collaborazione con i medici sviluppate strategie nutrizionali su misura e contribuite così attivamente a migliorare i risultati del trattamento
• Supervisione degli studenti

Se i 25-32 giorni di ferie all'anno non bastano, puoi verificare con noi la possibilità di ferie non retribuite. I nostri dipendenti ricevono anche un giorno libero aggiuntivo per il loro compleanno! GAV: Le nostre condizioni di lavoro si basano fondamentalmente sul contratto collettivo di lavoro (GAV) per il personale degli ospedali e delle cliniche bernesi. Gastronomia: Le nostre cucine a Burgdorf e Langnau lavorano soprattutto con prodotti stagionali, sani e locali. I dipendenti beneficiano di uno sconto e possono concedersi una variegata selezione di buffet. Sono disponibili anche forni a microonde per portare il proprio cibo. Il diritto umano moderno al centro: vogliamo essere un datore di lavoro moderno nei confronti dei nostri dipendenti e creare una buona atmosfera interpersonale in modo che i nostri dipendenti si sentano sempre al centro e a proprio agio. Parcheggio: i dipendenti possono utilizzare diversi parcheggi a seconda della posizione. L'accesso e la fatturazione avvengono tramite la carta Parkingpay. Occasioni: per promuovere la nostra cultura aziendale, concediamo ai nostri dipendenti un giorno libero. I colleghi dei diversi dipartimenti possono partecipare a una giornata dedicata allo sci, al ciclismo, alla moto, all'escursionismo, al divertimento, al mercatino di Natale o alla cultura. Sconti: nell'Intranet i nostri collaboratori trovano informazioni/link a numerose offerte interessanti e beneficiano di prezzi ridotti, ad esempio per piscine coperte, cinema, automobili o acquisti nelle farmacie regionali. descriptionByLocale.en:
With specialists at the two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, the Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents – around the clock. A varied everyday work routine awaits you with us: you accompany patients individually in outpatient and inpatient care and contribute your specialist knowledge directly to their therapy. Close interdisciplinary collaboration is particularly important to us - because together we achieve the best results for our patients. For nutritional advice at the Burgdorf location, we are looking for a maternity representative from September 1, 2026 until April 30, 2027: The Emmental Hospital provides high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents - around the clock - with specialists at the two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau. A varied everyday work routine awaits you with us: you accompany patients individually in outpatient and inpatient care and contribute your specialist knowledge directly to their therapy. Close interdisciplinary collaboration is particularly important to us - because together we achieve the best results for our patients. We are looking for nutritional advice at the Burgdorf location from September 1st, 2026 for a limited period until September 30th. April 2027 as part of a maternity replacement: Your tasks
• You carry out outpatient consultations in various specialist areas and accompany patients individually
• You carry out inpatient nutritional therapies in various specialist areas (oral, enteral, parenteral)
• In close collaboration with doctors, you develop tailor-made nutritional strategies and thus actively contribute to improving treatment results
• Supervision of students
• Conducting lectures as part of projects or outpatient rehabilitation such as pulmonary rehabilitation and cardiac rehabilitation) Your profile - what you bring with you
• You have completed a BSc degree in nutrition and dietetics
• Working in an interprofessional team is natural and enriching for you
• As a real team player, you are actively involved and enjoy supporting your colleagues
• You are a committed, service-oriented personality who accompanies patients competently and empathetically Our offer Holidays GAV Culinary Modern Human Right in the middle Parking Occasions Discounts

Close interdisciplinary collaboration is particularly important to us - because together we achieve the best results for our patients. For nutritional advice at the Burgdorf location, we are looking for a nutritionist BSc (a) 50% as part of a maternity replacement from September 1st, 2026 for a limited period until April 30th, 2027. Your tasks
• You carry out outpatient consultations in various specialist areas and accompany patients individually
• You carry out inpatient nutritional therapies in various specialist areas (oral, enteral, parenteral)
• In close cooperation with doctors You will develop tailor-made nutritional strategies and thus actively contribute to improving treatment results
• Supervising students
• Carrying out lectures as part of projects or outpatient rehabilitation such as: Pulmonary rehabilitation and cardiac rehabilitation) Your profile - what you bring with you
• You have completed a degree in Nutrition and Dietetics BSc
• Working in an interprofessional team is natural and enriching for you
• As a real team player, you actively participate and like to support your colleagues
• You are a committed, service-oriented personality who supports patients competently and empathetically Our offer Holidays: Special holiday plans? If the 25 to 32 days of vacation per year are not enough, you can check with us the possibility of unpaid vacation. Our employees also receive an additional day off for their birthday! GAV: Our employment conditions are fundamentally based on the collective employment agreement (GAV) for the staff of Bernese hospitals and clinics. Culinary: Our kitchens in Burgdorf and Langnau work largely with seasonal, healthy and local products. Employees benefit from a discount and can indulge in a varied buffet selection. Microwaves are also available for bringing your own food. Modern Human Right in the Middle: We want to be a modern employer towards our employees and create a good interpersonal atmosphere so that our employees always feel right in the middle and comfortable. Parking: Employees can use different parking spaces depending on the location. Access and billing are via Parkingpay card. Occasions: To promote our corporate culture, we give our employees a day off. Colleagues from different departments can take part in a skiing, cycling, motorbike, hiking, fun, Christmas market or culture day. Discounts: On the intranet, our employees can find information/links to numerous attractive offers and benefit from reduced prices, for example for indoor swimming pools, cinemas, cars or purchases from regional pharmacies. Special What we offer you Look forward to an exciting and varied field of activity that enables professional development as well as personal development. A collegial and committed team creates a working atmosphere that is characterized by appreciation and genuine collaboration. Attractive working conditions and fair, performance-oriented remuneration round off our offer. Kolleginnen/Kollegen aus verschiedenen Abteilungen können an einem Ski-, Velo-, Töff-, Wander-, Fun-, Weihnachtsmarkt- oder Kulturtag teilnehmen. Rabatte: Auf dem Intranet finden unsere Mitarbeitenden Angaben/Links zu zahlreichen attraktiven Angeboten und profitieren von reduzierten Preisen z.B. bei Hallenbad, Kino, Auto oder bei Bezügen in regionalen Apotheken. Besonderes Was wir dir bieten Freue dich auf ein spannendes und abwechslungsreiches Tätigkeitsfeld, das fachliche Weiterentwicklung ebenso ermöglicht wie persönliche Entfaltung. Ein kollegiales und engagiertes Team schafft ein Arbeitsklima, das von Wertschätzung und echter Zusammenarbeit geprägt ist. Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen und eine faire, leistungsorientierte Vergütung runden unser Angebot ab. Culinaire: Nos cuisines de Burgdorf et Langnau travaillent en grande partie avec des produits saisonniers, sains et locaux.
